LanguageData.LP_IceborneKin.label: children of the ice fields
LanguageData.LP_IceborneKin.description:
The tribe's ice fortress was breached by fire giants, and two frost giants fled south with two winter wolves until they finally stopped on an unfamiliar tundra.

Each frost giant has a bonded winter wolf; they carry short bows, spears, pemmican and leather. The ember clan's fire giants still remember this feud (goodwill -40).

Ice sheet or tundra recommended: frost giants don't fear cold and move fast in snow, but can't stand warm weather and greatly fear fire.

LanguageData.LP_IceborneKin.scenario.parts.GameStartD: The ice fortress walls fell under the fire giants' forge hammers. You headed south with two winter wolves, and the blizzard held back your pursuers.\n\nThe snow here isn't deep enough and the sky isn't cold enough, but it beats the fire of the forge. The winter wolves sniff at new prey beside you; it's time for this frozen land to hear the horn of winter.
